actions.action: Prune leaves that are mostly brown/yellow, broken, or lying on the ground
Peel off dry brown sheaths at the base if they come away easily
Check for root-bound signs (roots from drainage hole, fast drainage, quick drying)
If root-bound, repot one size up (5–8 cm wider) next spring
Check top 3–5 cm of soil and water deeply when dry
Fertilize monthly through summer with balanced houseplant fertilizer
Inspect leaf bases and stems for mealybugs or scale before bringing inside
Hose off the leaves before bringing inside
Bring plant indoors to brightest window before nights drop below 10 °C
